items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: is playing with Fats Waller, Bessie Smith, and Bunny Berrigan

ctx.x: We were working on -- (laughs) -- we were working in Philadelphia, at the Standard Theater. I was there, I told you I was in the pit band there. Well Bessie was there, and she was a star, naturally, and the place was packed, and Bessie liked a little taste. She liked to drink just like Herman.
